notes: Hermes_Solution_Article_Mst_Tbl.IsActive is not treated as governance approval by itself.
A Solution enters trusted zvec scope only when its solution_id and exact semantic content_sha256 are explicitly approved here.
The semantic hash covers reusable guidance fields only; mutable operational telemetry is excluded from trusted export content.
When synchronization runs, missing or semantically drifted approved Solutions are removed from solutions/approved and reported as errors until re-reviewed.
solutions/approved is generated output owned exclusively by sync_l2_approved_solutions.py; human-authored knowledge belongs in Git/facts instead.
